how_to_apply: Visit the official IGNOU website: ignou.ac.in
Locate the link for Advertisement No. 01/2026/ACD dated 19.09.2026 for teaching positions.
Register and fill out the prescribed online Application Proforma with accurate personal, academic, and category details.
Upload the required certificates and documents, including reservation-category proof where applicable.
Submit the online application before the last date, i.e., 20.10.2026 (or 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News, whichever is later).
Take a printout of the submitted online application.

Send the signed hard copy along with self-attested copies of necessary certificates to: The Director, Academic Coordination Division, IGNOU, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068, via registered or speed post, on or before 30.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Vacancy 2026 - School-wise and Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 42 vacancies (plus backlog vacancies from previous years) have been notified across 14 Schools of Studies for the posts of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. As per the notification, this also includes backlog vacancies of SC, ST, and OBC categories advertised in earlier years. Category Codes: UR - Unreserved; SC - Scheduled Caste; ST - Scheduled Tribe; OBC - Other Backward Classes; EWS - Economically Weaker Sections; PwBD - Persons with Benchmark Disability; PwBD(a) - Blindness and Low Vision; PwBD(c) - Locomotor Disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims, and muscular dystrophy.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The minimum eligibility conditions for all posts shall be as per the University Grants Commission (UGC) Regulations, 2018, and subsequent amendments, along with the norms of concerned regulatory bodies such as NCTE and MCI, wherever applicable. The cut-off date for determining eligibility conditions will be the last date of receipt of online applications.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Important Links
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed their postgraduate degree in life sciences can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and M.Sc Life Sciences Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more research opportunities can also explore the latest Delhi Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check New Delhi Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding a postgraduate degree in science can also browse more M.Sc Government Jobs and Research Fellow Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 20.10.2026, or 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News, whichever is later.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 42 vacancies have been notified for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts across 14 Schools of Studies, in addition to backlog vacancies from previous years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for an IGNOU Professor in 2026?
faq.answer: The Professor post carries Academic Level 14 of the 7th CPC, with a pay scale of Rs. 1,44,200 – Rs. 2,18,200.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for an IGNOU Assistant Professor in 2026?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor post carries Academic Level 10 of the 7th CPC, with a pay scale of Rs. 57,700 – Rs. 1,82,400.

faq.question: Q5. What is the eligibility for IGNOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Minimum eligibility is as per UGC Regulations, 2018 (and subsequent amendments) and relevant regulatory body norms such as NCTE and MCI, wherever applicable. The cut-off date for eligibility is the last date of receipt of online applications.

faq.question: Q6. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: To The Director, Academic Coordination Division, Indira Gandhi National Open University, Maidan Garhi, New Delhi-110068, by registered or speed post, on or before 30.10.2026.
